caption:
After work, Mr Turtle games and streams until late. One more round turns into three hours, and his wrists and neck feel stiff.

Long stretches in one position can tire the wrists and neck. Remedial massage can help things feel easier, and it works well alongside regular breaks.

Hybi's gamer reset: stand and walk about every hour, wrist stretches 20 seconds each way, screen at eye level with elbows by your side, and chin tucks 5 seconds × 10.

Hands tingling at night or a weaker grip are worth an assessment first. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🎮

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
